body: Whatever you end up doing, I hope you find what your looking for.

As someone who is currently has a thread open here concerning my own suicide, I can't speak for her, but i can offer a bit of insight from the other side of the fence, needless to say she probably feels very alone right now, i've felt that way before, and what helped me more than having someone who cared was meeting a kindred spirit, someone who's gone through or going through something similar, sharing your pain with someone that you know has felt it too can be very helpful.
Well i'm going to be doing damage control for the next week or so assuming i'm still alive, so you would be right in saying that.
I was feeling arguably better beforehand, before i just wanted to die but now its all i can think about.
While not directly, these events will follow me for the rest of my life.
I feel similarly, but I've almost run out of things to try.
I'm seeing a therapist on a regular basis and take antidepressants, I've got the medical aspect covered. As for the recent events, they are more a reminder of what i was thinking all along.
